long.title: Zombie Animals Are Real (And One Might Be Inside You)
long.comment: 🧟 Which of these five would make the scariest Halloween costume? Best answer gets read out in the next episode 👇
long.description:
Are zombie animals real? Yes. Meatball tells the true story of five animals whose bodies get driven by something else: the zombie-ant fungus and its death grip, the emerald wasp that walks a cockroach on a leash, the hairworm that makes crickets jump into water, the snail with throbbing striped eyes, and the parasite that makes rats like the smell of cats. One of them has infected somewhere between a quarter and a third of all people. It's at the end.

Which one would make the scariest Halloween costume? Best answer gets read out next episode 👇
